Reproduction: Open Sensory > Green QC with a clean profile and no measurement fixture; inspect moisture, aw, density and meter state. Also open Pro Operations and inspect panel evidence.
Expected: Unmeasured values start blank/UNKNOWN/NOT_MEASURED; panel scores and citations come only from real linked records with provenance.
Actual: Source initializes moisture 10.8, aw 0.585, density 710.0 and measured flags true; panel scores/citation-like values are hardcoded UI state. Runtime repro not executed.
Proposed fix: Remove fabricated defaults in a scoped Android worktree; require explicit measured input, instrument metadata, and source-linked persisted panel records; add regression assertions for blank/unknown states.

Reproduction: Open CVA and invoke Lock, JSON, CSV; open Green QC and invoke JSON/CSV; invoke Operations integrity seal. Inspect a user-selected export destination and persisted record.
Expected: Lock freezes a real persisted revision, hash equals canonical serialized record bytes, export creates a valid file, and import round-trip preserves values/provenance.
Actual: CVA lock assigns a UUID substring labeled SHA-256; CVA buttons show success notices; Green QC discards generated strings and shows success; Operations hashes a dummy literal. Runtime repro not executed.
Proposed fix: Route actions through use cases and SAF CreateDocument; hash the exact canonical export payload; test output bytes, checksum, roundtrip, failure, and cancellation.

Reproduction: Create a new S4 cupping session, edit multiple fields, background/rotate/force-stop the disposable app, relaunch, and compare record IDs and values; tap Log to Brew Journal and inspect journal.
Expected: Draft/session is durable and recoverable; log action creates a linked immutable journal record; related legacy data stay unchanged.
Actual: Five S4 sections receive no ViewModel or persistence callbacks; fields use local Compose state; Log to Brew Journal only updates a success message. No durable S4 repository link found.
Proposed fix: Add additive versioned persistence/use cases and recovery tests; bridge journal via existing repository; retain legacy IDs and audit history.

Reproduction: In an isolated test worktree, decode a schema-v2 backup and Room record containing a pre-sourceChunkIds ChatMessage plus a non-empty historic Recipe; open through BackupCodec/DataRepository.
Expected: Missing fields receive documented safe defaults, records open/restore, IDs and payload meaning survive roundtrip.
Actual: Backup v2 migration adds only top-level estimates; nested models are validated as current; validation dereferences sourceChunkIds. Existing v2 test fixture has no chat/recipe rows. Runtime failure not reproduced.
Proposed fix: Add old nested JSON fixtures and tolerant explicit decoder/migration; assert stable IDs/counts and atomic restore without destructive migration.

Reproduction: On a disposable device, use the Brew Connect Scale action and verify the driver type, permissions, live values, disconnect recovery, and actual supported-scale identity.
Expected: Real BLE hardware is scanned/paired with user permission; measurements are clearly actual; unsupported scale falls back to manual mode.
Actual: UI calls connectMockScale() and only SimulatedBleScaleDriver was found; no production GATT implementation or Bluetooth permissions found. No BLE device test run.
Proposed fix: Keep mock explicitly labeled as simulation; implement/verify GATT in a scoped slice only if supported hardware is in scope; add hardware-gated acceptance.

Reproduction: Start manual brew, background or kill the disposable app, relaunch, and verify monotonic elapsed time, stage, targets, weigh-ins and journal outcome.
Expected: Active brew resumes without timer drift or lost/duplicate data.
Actual: Snapshot export/restore helpers exist but no persistence/lifecycle caller was located. Device/process-death repro not run.
Evidence: CoffeeViewModelBrewSession.kt:537 onward; no caller found by repository-wide search
Proposed fix: Connect timer snapshot to durable lifecycle storage or foreground service as specified; add process recreation regression using a disposable profile.

Reproduction: Review the referenced Sprint 03 video and record timestamped claims in the evidence inventory; compare TASKS completion claim to source.
Expected: Every video-derived behavior has timestamped, verified evidence before it is marked complete.
Actual: Dripper source still says PENDING_VIDEO_REVIEW; Sprint 03 says video content could not be verified; TASKS marks BR-17 complete.

Reproduction: Choose SCA_CVA_CURRENT and compare every field, scale, unit, validation, calculation and license/source against the current authorized SCA form mapping.
Expected: Current-standard mode uses a source-verified mapping and permitted content; if any field cannot be verified, mode is blocked and CUSTOM_RESEARCH is labeled.

Reproduction: Bind the 39/40 Android RAG receipt and 40/40 device candidate to exact build SHA, device, fixture hash, airplane-mode/network evidence, and test report.
Expected: One commit-bound device receipt agrees across independent evidence and separates retrieval from answer faithfulness/tool quality.
Actual: TASKS says Android 39/40 failed and later host 40/40 is not Android proof; docs/VERIFICATION reports a 40/40 device candidate; current HEAD receipt not established.

Reproduction: Photograph an actual coffee label under supported lighting with the real capture/picker path; review OCR draft, corrections, persisted metadata and provenance offline.
Expected: OCR only drafts supported recognized values; unknown stays unknown; user reviews/corrects before saving; no label is silently fabricated.
Actual: Picker/camera and OCR source/test exist, but OpenSpec real-photo acceptance is unchecked and instrumentation uses a synthetic text bitmap. No real-label test run.
Proposed fix: Run consented real label cases on disposable device with fixture rights; assert corrections, UNKNOWN states, offline behavior, and saved source photo.

Reproduction: Open Pro Operations with clean profile and inspect sharing consent before attempting export.
Expected: Consent is false/unset until the user explicitly opts in; each export records the consented scope.
Actual: shareConsent initializes true in local UI state, before affirmative user action. No consent acceptance test found.
Proposed fix: Default to false; capture explicit opt-in and export scope in a durable audit record; add test that fresh profile has no consent.

Reproduction: Check required S4 provenance deliverables and verify all bundled lesson/reference assets include source, version, rights, and review metadata.
Expected: Every content unit has a maintained source/license/version record; release gate blocks unsupported assets.
Actual: Lesson source URLs exist, but SENSORY_CONTENT_SOURCE_REGISTER.md is absent and complete per-item rights/provenance audit is not evidenced.
Proposed fix: Build a source register with allowed paraphrase/attribution fields and update content only from authorized sources; retain generic non-proprietary training content.

Reproduction: Compare the complete recipe IDs, steps and measurement fields from v1.9.5 CuratedCoffeeCatalog.kt with the v1.9.6+ production catalog and a disposable pre-upgrade backup; verify every record can still be browsed/restored without inventing measurements.
Expected: Every shipped recipe identity and user record is accounted for across upgrades. Preserve verified recipe content and historical user data; represent unsupported historical measurement claims as UNKNOWN until provenance is verified.
Actual: v1.9.5 production CuratedCoffeeCatalog.kt and CuratedCoffeeCatalogTest.kt are removed in v1.9.6; similar recipe-shaped data moved to BrewScenarioFixtures.kt under an explicit test-only/synthetic contract. Current SeedData.sampleRecipes is empty; a separate 80-entry champion catalog exists but stable old IDs/content are not reconciled. No installed database was inspected, so user-record loss is not proven.
Proposed fix: Build an authorized, provenance-bearing historical manifest; compare IDs/steps and the champion catalog; add copied-backup/seed-upgrade regression tests preserving IDs and user edits. Do not restore test fixtures or claim their measurements are real.
Verdict: SPEC_CONFLICT; historical source removal confirmed, runtime/data parity NOT_RUN

Reproduction: Follow the v1.14.5 release-notes download and compare its artifact size with GitHub release asset metadata.
Expected: Release documentation links to the canonical coffee-creator repository and reports the exact uploaded asset size/hash.
Actual: GitHub release asset API reports repository Adrian463588/coffee-creator, size 123036057 bytes, and SHA-256 447ccdde1cafc1799bb6a11af4e4c32a1344a4e11708beea64ec1fc2621a0f09. docs/releases/v1.14.5.md reports 123039143 bytes and its curl command points to murchid21/CoffeCreator. Proposed fix: Correct the release note download owner and asset size from the canonical release API; validate the direct download URL and digest before updating README/history.

Reproduction: At tagged v1.14.3 and v1.14.4, compare public release notes claims for Green QC measurement provenance, exports, CVA-to-journal logging, persistent records and verified migration with the exact source at the same tags.
Expected: Published acceptance/hardware claims match the tagged implementation and have commit-bound logs/screenshots/device fixtures; unsupported results are labeled NOT_RUN.
Actual: The v1.14.3 release claims zero fabricated readings and instrument-grounded values while same-tag SensorySprint04Screens.kt initializes 10.8, 0.585, and 710.0, and its release describes JSON/CSV SHA sealing while the code builds a UUID-prefixed pseudo-hash. v1.14.4 claims one-click journal logging, stable persistent S4 records and verified restore, while same-tag source has local form state and no durable S4 repository callback. The public release bodies retain these claims.
Proposed fix: Correct or qualify inaccurate historical release claims with exact evidence, and preserve the source-level defects as release blockers until the behaviors are implemented and independently verified.
